title: Lapis Potion
description: This Mod is adding lapis potion when you drink it you give full netherite set Need 6 diamond blocks 1 lapis block and 1 glass bottle in inventory then open the book and click on a yellow word.
body:
**💎 What is Lapis Potion?**
Lapis Potion is a small, balanced mod that adds a powerful endgame consumable to Minecraft.

When you drink the Lapis Potion, you instantly receive:

Full set of Netherite armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)

Netherite sword, pickaxe, axe, and shovel

All items come with enchants (Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Sharpness V, Efficiency V, and more)

Powerful status effects: Strength II, Resistance II, Fire Resistance, Night Vision, and Luck III

**🧪 How to obtain it?**
To craft the Lapis Potion, you need:

6 Diamond Blocks

1 Lapis Lazuli Block

1 Glass Bottle

Once you have all the ingredients in your inventory, open the book named "Lapis Potion" (given to you on your first join) and click on the golden text to claim your potion.

**⚖️ Balance**
The potion is designed to be powerful but fair:

6 Diamond Blocks = 54 diamonds — requires serious mining and exploration

Lapis Block — not always easy to find

The items and effects are temporary or require maintenance (armor durability, tool repairs)

The potion is single-use, so you'll need to gather resources again for another one

**🖥️ Side Requirements**
This mod is universal — it must be installed on both the client and the server to work properly, because it adds a new custom item.

📦 **Download & Install**
Download the .jar file

Place it in your mods folder (both client and server)

Launch the game with Forge 1.20.1

Enjoy!
